counter_evidence.text: The current error onset (~22:51:54) is about 8 minutes after the new checkout pod first appears (22:42:54), but the same payment 'Invalid token' error and a checkout PlaceOrder error ratio of 1 already occurred at 22:04:54 / 21:58:54-22:10:54, before the 22:41:43Z rollout, so the rollout's timing does not explain the failure mechanism.

payment is not timing out and no failing downstream dependency of payment is visible: the failing payment Charge span completed in 702 us (second sample 520 us) with only a 140-172 us 'charge' child span, and payment dns.lookup and tcp.connect span rates were 0 across 21:53:54-22:54:04.

fact.text: The alert's own PromQL ratio for otel-demo/checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder server spans evaluates to 1 at 22:51:54, 22:52:54 and 22:53:54, and was 0 from 22:14:54 through 22:50:54 (earlier values 1 until 22:10:54, then 0.833, 0.5, 0.375, 0).

checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate went from 0 at 22:50:54 to 0.0331, 0.0354 and 0.0365 spans/s at 22:51:54, 22:52:54 and 22:53:54, while STATUS_CODE_UNSET for the same operation was 0 in those minutes.

In traces at 22:51-22:52 the checkout server span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder is ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code=13 and otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; its child client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (service checkout) is ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code=2 and the same description.

The payment service's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (service payment, service_version 2.0.2) is ERROR with grpc.error_name 'Error', grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and exception.stacktrace 'at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13) ... at async Object.chargeServiceHandler [as charge] (/usr/src/app/index.js:21:22)', duration 702 us (second sample 520 us); its only child is a 'charge' span of 143-172 us with no status tags.

payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR rate was 0.025, 0.0292 and 0.0375 spans/s at 22:51:54-22:53:54 while STATUS_CODE_UNSET was 0 over the same minutes, i.e. all observed Charge server spans were errors at alert time.

The identical payment failure existed before the 22:41:43Z checkout rollout: in a trace at 22:04:54 the payment Charge server span is ERROR with the same 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' message and the same /usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13 stack, checkout PlaceOrder is ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code=13, and the alert ratio was 1 from 21:58:54 to 22:10:54.

The fault originates in the payment workload, not checkout: the ERROR span whose exception is thrown from /usr/src/app/charge.js belongs to service payment 2.0.2, whose single ReplicaSet payment-6f7bc865d6 (pod payment-6f7bc865d6-k4hpb) was unchanged and presented for the whole hour, while checkout only propagates the error as rpc.grpc.status_code=13 on PlaceOrder.

Checkout pod turnover was observed: pod checkout-7886979698-48xh8 first appears at 22:42:54 and old pod checkout-8674764b75-q2tgj last appears at 22:41:54; both report image_id ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:5ab0d7b9003206a32c72ef48b42a535c3f70565251d7d832f86fe9f249f16635, and kube_replicaset_owner shows checkout-7886979698 only from 22:42:54 onward while payment stayed on payment-6f7bc865d6 all hour.

No container restarts occurred over 21:53:54-22:54:04: kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total increase was 0 for payment-6f7bc865d6-k4hpb, checkout-7886979698-48xh8 and checkout-8674764b75-q2tgj, and all three pods reported kube_pod_status_ready=1 throughout their presence in the window.

The failure propagated to callers in the sampled 22:51-22:52 traces: frontend 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' ERROR http.status_code=500 with message '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card: could not charge the card: ...', frontend 'POST /api/checkout' 500, frontend 'POST' 500, frontend-proxy 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' 500, and load-generator 'POST' 500.

Checked in 22:48:15-22:54:04: the only STATUS_CODE_ERROR series among payment, checkout, cart, currency, shipping, product-catalog and email were checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and checkout oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge client spans and payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge; cart, shipping, product-catalog and email spans showed only STATUS_CODE_UNSET and currency spans STATUS_CODE_OK.

hypothesis.text: payment's charge handler is applying a conditional payment-failure rule (a fault-injection gate) that switches on and off; the ~40-minute on/off cadence from 20:24 to 22:54 predates and outlasts individual pod changes. Whether the gate is a flagd flag, a deployment configuration value, or baggage-derived (the message carries 'app.loyalty.level=gold') cannot be determined from traces.

A flagd-evaluated flag in payment could be the toggle, but this is unconfirmed: payment's grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat span appears only at ~0.0042 spans/s with no error status, and no flagd span appears under the failing payment Charge span in the sampled traces.

recommendation.text: Advisory: inspect the payment service's fault-injection/feature-flag configuration (and the checkout configuration changed by release rel-20261117224143) and the payment logs to identify the exact switch that makes charge.js reject requests; change history and pod logs are not integrated in this Run.

report.summary: The alert is firing because otel-demo/checkout PlaceOrder requests fail whenever the payment service's Charge call fails.
